3016 lepton {lep-ton'}

與 03013 同源的衍生字的中性; TDNT - 4:233,*; 形容詞

欽定本 - mite 3; 3

1) 細薄的, 微小的
2) 一個小銅幣, 約美金一毛的五分之一 (#可 12:42; 路 12:59; 21:2|)
record.edic_text:
3016 lepton {lep-ton'}

neuter of a derivative of the same as 3013; TDNT - 4:233,*; adj

AV - mite 3; 3

1) thin, small
2) a small brass coin, equivalent to the eighth part of an "as",
   worth about a 1/5 of a cent
